answer: New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 92 epochs rather than arriving at once. Farming becomes a haven bet on surviving 92 epochs of grading, and every onyx settlement recomputes the ivory schedule, so an attacker who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 16 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 34 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
